comparator.sourceNotes: The formal 2026-2027 regulations define the redesigned curriculum for the student cohort entering in 2026. They account for the complete 180 EC as 60 EC in Year 1, 60 EC in Year 2, a 30-EC minor and three 10-EC graduation-portfolio seminars in Year 3. The first-listed current Faculty-Wide Course option, Cultural Heritage: Heritage in a Changing World, is used as the neutral official-order tie-break. Students choose three of five graduation seminars; Neurolinguistics, Psycholinguistics and Developmental Language Disorders, and Syntax are the first three in the formal order and are selected independently of UCR fit. These restricted choices are not named formal routes, so no route is assigned.

exception.reason: The University of Groningen bachelor requires a cumulative scientific language sequence spanning phonology, syntax, morphology, semantics, pragmatics, language acquisition and change, psycholinguistics, neurolinguistics, clinical linguistics, language and speech disorders, dyslexia, neuroimaging, statistics and advanced graduation seminars. UCR offers one dedicated Psycholinguistics course and useful neighbouring study in cognition, psychology, communication, rhetoric, AI and data science, but it has no coherent foundation in structural linguistics and no clinical- or neurolinguistics progression. A 24-course response would replace most of the target discipline with adjacent fields rather than provide a defensible Linguistics comparator.
exception.curriculumContext: The formal 2026-2027 regulations define a redesigned programme for the 2026 entering cohort and account for all 180 EC. Year one is 60 EC in language and speech disorders, processing and neuroimaging, phonology and syntax, language change and contact, semantics, Humane AI, language acquisition and dyslexia. Year two is 60 EC in clinical linguistics, morphology, advanced semantics, pragmatics, statistics, advanced syntax, one Faculty-Wide Course, a psycholinguistics project and advanced phonology. Year three comprises a 30-EC minor plus three of five 10-EC graduation-portfolio seminars. The first-listed permissible choices are used as neutral tie-breaks, not because of UCR provision.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 current enriched UCR workbook rows, including descriptions, outline-derived profiles, disciplines, topics, methods, prerequisites and planned Fall 2026 cohort terms. HCBCOGN312 Psycholinguistics directly studies language processing, production, comprehension, acquisition, impairments and the neuroscience of language. HCBGATE102 Introduction to Brain & Behavior, HCBCOGN112 Neurobiology, HCBCOGN311 Higher Order Functions and psychology courses provide adjacent cognitive, neurological and behavioural foundations. MCCCOMM211 Style & Meaning examines linguistic choices in texts, while MCCCOMM111 The Art of Rhetorical Communication, MCCCOMM213 Rhetoric in Action, MCCCOMM311 Persuasive Communication and MCCCOMM312 Creative Communication Laboratory address rhetoric, discourse and communication rather than linguistic structure. MCCCOMM112 Dutch is practical language learning; programming, AI and data-science courses add computational tools. The workbook nevertheless contains no cumulative sequence in phonetics or phonology, syntax, morphology, formal semantics and pragmatics, language acquisition and change, clinical linguistics, speech and language pathology, dyslexia, neurolinguistics or language neuroimaging. It therefore cannot support 23 non-PPD courses with a concrete Linguistics rationale or reproduce the external foundation-to-specialisation progression.
